wiki.title: Eric Wimberger
wiki.extract: Eric Wimberger (born April 2, 1979) is an American lawyer and Republican politician from De Pere, Wisconsin. He is a member of the Wisconsin Senate, representing Wisconsin's 2nd Senate district since January 2025; he previously represented the 30th Senate district from 2021 until 2025. Earlier in his career, he served as a United States Marine Corps officer for four years in the Judge Advocate Division.
